Let's try to brainstorm a way to annotate some of our DEGs.


let's start with extracting protein sequences from genes of interest

```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# 1. Load the peptide FASTA file
pep_seqs <- readAAStringSet("C:/Users/britt/Documents/R/BogarLab/data/Psme.1_0.pep.fa.gz")
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 2. Extract the gene IDs (row names)
target_gene_ids <- rownames(top10.trt)

# 3. Quick check of your IDs
head(target_gene_ids)
length(target_gene_ids)
```




```{r}
# 2. Filter for your target DEGs
# (Ensure target_gene_ids matches the exact header format in names(pep_seqs))
selected_peps <- pep_seqs[names(pep_seqs) %in% target_gene_ids]

```


```{r}
# 3. Export the subset for eggNOG-mapper
writeXStringSet(selected_peps, "degs_for_eggnog.fasta")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. Read Mercator text output
mercator_raw <- read.delim(
  "psme.results.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  comment.char = "#",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
mercator_annot <- mercator_raw %>%
  select(
    gene_id = IDENTIFIER,
    bin_code = BINCODE,
    description = NAME
  ) %>%
  # Remove quotation marks if Mercator wrapped IDs in quotes
  mutate(
    gene_id = gsub("'", "", gene_id),
    clean_label = paste0(description, " (", gene_id, ")")
  )

mercator_annot
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# 1. Read the annotations file while filtering header metadata
eggnog_data <- read_tsv(
  "query.emapper.annotations",
  comment = "##",       # Skips double-hash header info
  col_names = TRUE      # Uses the single-hash header line for column names
)

# 2. Fix the first column name (it often inherits a '#' from the header line)
colnames(eggnog_data)[1] <- "query"

# 3. Select the most useful columns for your RNA-seq project
library(dplyr)

# Extract and clean annotations matching your exact headers
clean_annotations <- eggnog_data %>%
  select(
    gene_id = query,
    symbol = Preferred_name,
    description = eggNOG_OGs,  # Uses Orthologous Group info for function
    go_terms = GOs,
    kegg_pathways = KEGG_Pathway,
    cog_category = COG_category,
    pfam = PFAMs
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Clean up empty/dash values
    symbol = ifelse(symbol == "-" | is.na(symbol), gene_id, symbol),
    description = ifelse(description == "-" | is.na(description), "Uncharacterized protein", description),
    
    # Create a concise label for plots and heatmaps
    clean_label = paste0(symbol, " (", gene_id, ")")
  )

# Verify the cleaned table
clean_annotations
```
